From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthsync.com>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@healthsync.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Technical showcase & attendee alignment

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the 30-minute discovery earlier today. Helpful to hear more about HealthSync's throughput needs and the two specific pain points you raised around inference cost and cold-start latency for your nightly batch jobs. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a productive technical showcase: 

Recap (very brief)
- Primary goal: validate that Redwood Dedicated can meet 99th-percentile latency SLOs for your 1k req/min steady-state and reduce per-token cost by ~25% using batching + KV cache.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data flows (no PHI in the hosted demo), AWS us-west-2 preferred, and SRE will want rollout/fallback policy details.

Proposed technical showcase (what we'll cover)
- 20m: Architecture & runtime overview (Diego)
- 25m: Live run showing prefix caching, quantization choices, and latency/cost numbers on a representative workload (Marissa + Diego)
- 15m: Q&A and next steps (open)

Two proposed 90-minute windows (PT):
- Wednesday Aug 11: 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thursday Aug 12: 13:00–14:30 PT

Ask: can you confirm which window works and who from your side will attend (engineering, SRE, product)? Also let us know whether you'd prefer a Zoom or Google Meet link and whether we should prepare a short anonymized dataset for the live run (we can also run against a synthetic workload).

I've attached a draft agenda and an environment checklist so SRE can confirm network/credential prerequisites before the demo. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm the time and attendee list.

Thanks —
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: tech-showcase-agenda.pdf (attachment stub), env-checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)
